title: 3630. Partition Array for Maximum XOR and AND

examples.explanation: One optimal partition is: A = [3], XOR(A) = 3 B = [2], AND(B) = 2 C = [], XOR(C) = 0 The maximum value of: XOR(A) + AND(B) + XOR(C) = 3 + 2 + 0 = 5. Thus, the answer is 5.
One optimal partition is: A = [1], XOR(A) = 1 B = [2], AND(B) = 2 C = [3], XOR(C) = 3 The maximum value of: XOR(A) + AND(B) + XOR(C) = 1 + 2 + 3 = 6. Thus, the answer is 6.
One optimal partition is: A = [7], XOR(A) = 7 B = [2,3], AND(B) = 2 C = [6], XOR(C) = 6 The maximum value of: XOR(A) + AND(B) + XOR(C) = 7 + 2 + 6 = 15. Thus, the answer is 15.

hints: Let s = XOR of all elements not in B.
We want to choose a value x (a subset‐XOR of the "remaining" elements) to maximize x + (s XOR x).
Observe that x + (s XOR x) = s + 2 * (x AND ~s).
To do this efficiently, build a linear XOR basis over the values nums[j] & ~s for each index j not in B.
Finally, greedily extract the maximum x from that basis.
